L10: Reset behavior: enable bit cleared; transmit-empty flag set; receive-flag cleared after reset.
L10: Master mode transmission: write to data register + clock-cycle delay + N edges + receive-flag set.
L10: Slave mode transmission: select line goes LOW + N edges from master + receive-flag set after last edge.
L10: Mode fault / collision detection.
L10: All clock polarity/phase combinations.
L10: MSB-first vs LSB-first byte ordering.
L10: Bidirectional mode (single data pin).
L10: Receive overrun (flag-serviced-too-late).
L10: Baud rate divisor sweep.
L10: Wait/Stop mode behavior.
L16: Conform to MIL-STD-1553B (1978) or MIL-STD-1553C (Feb 2018, functionally equivalent).
L16: Bit coding: Manchester II bi-phase at 1.0 Mbit/s.
L16: Word framing: 3 µs sync + 16 data bits + 1 odd-parity bit = 20 µs per word.
L16: Distinct sync polarity: Command/Status sync = HIGH 1.5 µs then LOW 1.5 µs; Data sync = LOW 1.5 µs then HIGH 1.5 µs.
L16: Odd parity computed over the 16 data bits of each word.
L16: Command Word layout: bits 1-5 = RT address (5 bits); bit 6 = T/R; bits 7-11 = Subaddress or Mode Code selector; bits 12-
L16: Status Word layout: bits 1-5 = RT address echo; bit 6 = Message Error; bit 7 = Instrumentation; bit 8 = Service Request;
L16: Word Count field of 5 bits encoding 1..32 data words; binary 00000 = 32 (special).
L16: RT address range 0-30 valid; address 31 reserved for broadcast.
L16: Subaddress 0 and 31 reserved for Mode Codes.
L16: Inter-message gap ≥ 4 µs minimum.
L16: RT response time 4-12 µs after the last bit of the command word.
L16: BC no-response timeout = 14 µs.
L16: Implement mandatory Mode Codes: Transmit Status Word (00010), Transmit Last Command (10010), Transmit BIT Word (10011).
L16: Bus is dual-redundant (Bus A + Bus B); a message travels on only one bus at a time.
L16: Twinax bus characteristic impedance 70-85 Ω (78 Ω nominal); transmitter 18-27 Vp-p.
L16: Manchester encoding requires a mid-bit transition; missing or wrong-polarity transition is an encoding error.
L16: Broadcast (RT address 31): receiving RTs accept data but SHALL NOT transmit a Status Word.
